Marina (infra-arch): Heads-up — we need to land a concrete prioritization for routing contracts and isolation tiers this quarter. Major asks from two enterprise pilots: strict per-tenant regional isolation and predictable latency SLAs.
Jason (eng-platform): +1. Can we scope a 3-tier routing model: edge-affinity, regional-dedicated, and global-fallback?
Rachel (product): That aligns with customer asks. Need launch criteria though: what metrics gate GA? p99 latency, per-tenant throughput isolation, and a migration path doc.
Samir (sales-eng): Customers want clear contracts: e.g., "regional-dedicated" = reserved capacity, 99.9% regional availability, and data residency guarantee. Price premium expected.
Marina (infra-arch): Proposed minimal acceptance criteria for a tier: 
- p50/p95/p99 latency baseline vs current hosted
- proof of enforcement for tenant slices (no cross-tenant KV leakage)
- automated rollback when isolation capacity falls below threshold
- documented traffic-shaping policy
Jason (eng-platform): From an implementation POV: we can use routing-policy DSL + policy tags on requests. Quick outline: 
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - name: regional-dedicated
    match: customer.region == request.region and customer.tier == premium
    action: route_to: dedicated-pool-${region}
```
Rachel (product): Love the DSL example. For rollout: P0 customers go first, then a 1% canary to baseline hosts, 10% next day, then 100% staged over 2 weeks if metrics ok. Define explicit SLOs at each stage.
Marina (infra-arch): Important tradeoff: strict segregation reduces bin-packing efficiency. We need cost bands and acceptance thresholds (e.g., eviction policy when dedicated pool < 30% free). Should we allow soft-eviction with fallback to global-fallback under emergency?
Samir (sales-eng): Customers will accept fallback if it's documented and only under emergency, but it must be auditable and visible in Console + they need advance notice windows in contract.
Jason (eng-platform): Ops checklist for GA: deploy migration CLI, telemetry for isolation breach alerts, per-tenant RBAC for routing rules, and a self-serve simulation mode (dry-run).
Marina (infra-arch): Action items: @Jason draft RFC for routing DSL + eviction semantics (due EOW), @Rachel define launch-SLOs and customer-contract language (due Tue), @Samir collect top-3 pilot customer constraints into a short appendix. I'll prototype policy simulator.
DevOps Bot: New task created — RFC: routing-dsl-eviction (assignee: Jason). Due: 4281234600.
Rachel (product): One more: include quantization/compute profiles in the routing metadata so cheaper quantized variants can be selected by policy for cost-sensitive tenants.
Marina (infra-arch): Good call. We'll add model-variant hints to policy. Ok team — syncing in architecture sync on Friday to finalize prioritization. :thumbsup:
